name: Amalia
source:
Amalia, along with her fiancée, Demi, is a co-owner of the restaurant Saffron. Unlike her partner, she is very realistic and straight-forward. The two women are struggling in reviving their love for both their business and each other, until Your Character steps in.

Despite the Greek government's refusal to recognize same-gender marriage, Amalia and Demi are still planning to host a wedding ceremony.
